purpose: Exploratory fit-only scan of each block-31 attention head's terminal contribution to the layer-30 word-audio patch effect
system_prompt: Answer the spoken question with one color word.
capture_and_patch_site: self_attn.o_proj input at terminal prompt token, contiguous head_dim=128 slices in 16-head concatenation; full-prompt prefill only
upstream_patch: post-block layer30 donor state at nominal word-slot audio placeholder positions
primary_endpoint: complete donor-color answer with normal EOS
analysis: Report all 16 heads and both directions separately, no best-head-only claim; any selected head must be tested on unseen word pairs and voices
interpretation_limit: A head output slice is an activation intervention, not evidence of its attention pattern or a uniquely necessary natural circuit. This is a posthoc fit-only scan of one lexical pair.
